subtitle: Building Materials

授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Gain basic knowledge of materials science for safe and comfortable buildings.

Students gain understanding of the characteristics of building materials.
Main materials to be studied: timber, steel products, cement concrete, finishing materials, functional materials
advice:
This is a basic course in architectural materials science. We will cover the following:

1. Summary of architectural materials
2. Cement-concreate
3. Steel products
4. Timber
5. Functional materials and finishing materials

Students are required to prepare for lectures by reading the textbook in advance.
Students are required to submit a report on their preparations.

activityGoals.body: Students understand the physical characteristics of each architectural material and scientifically describe it a
Students can describe the intended purposes of architectural materials in consideration of architectural plans,
Students can describe the characteristics of various architectural materials.
